subject: Find a specific quantile value across groups in dataframe

messages.author: 334d5e0a5ee5bb44
messages.subject: Find a specific quantile value across groups in dataframe
parts:
sorry for double post - moving this message into a new thread.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I am trying to find the 85th quantile value across groups in a dataframe.

For example, I want to the find the 85th percentile price across each color group in the diamonds dataset.

require(ggplot2)
require(plyr)

data(diamonds)
ddply(diamonds, .(color), subset, price == quantile(price, .85))

which gives the results below, which are not what is expected. I'm looking for one row for each of the 7 colors, but some colors aren't listed, and some are listed twice.

Is this possible to do with plyr or tapply?

Thanks

>  carat             cut color clarity depth table price    x    y    z
>1  1.00 Very Good       F     VS1  60.4    59  7204 6.40 6.51 3.90
>2  1.00   Premium       F    VVS2  61.9    61  7204 6.45 6.32 3.95

>4  1.53         Ideal       H     SI2  61.9    57  8499 7.42 7.34 4.57

messages.subject: Re: Find a specific quantile value across groups in dataframe
parts:
Remember that if there are an even number of samples, the "median" is
defined at the midpoint of the two middle samples, even if no single
sample is at the median. I think that "quantile" does a similar thing
(generalized), which is why subset() is not picking up any rows that
exactly match the 85th %ile in some groups (and more than one in other
groups.)

Just use 'with':

ddply(diamonds, .(color), with, quantile(price, .85))
